name: Nocturne
reference: Editorial studio work in dark mode (Instrument, Koto): large serif statements, a small sans caption, a thin rule.
pattern: Warm black ground, warm white serif type, one stone grey.
personality: A considered statement. Words fade in one by one in a large serif.

motion.character: Word-by-word fades 80 ms apart, 500 ms ease-out; the camera barely moves.
motion.transitions: A slow fade through the ground.

grammar: A large serif statement is the image.
A small sans caption names the speaker or source, under a thin rule.

pictures.note: A dark, warm photograph behind the serif statement, dimmed so the words read: a slow push toward it while the words arrive.

footage.note: Slow, dark atmosphere: a window at night, smoke, a street light.

music.feel: ambient piano and soft strings, nocturnal, reflective

hits.note: No effects: the words arrive in silence over the bed.

compose.how: The statement is the image: the quote in the large serif fills the text-safe width (quote fits each statement to it), the speaker under a thin rule. On the dark ground, or on one picture: `quote({ picture })` sets the picture under the statement as the field that fills the frame, dimmed behind type, the statement on it at the same width. Never a picture stacked under the statement or across its edge, and no plate behind the words (no decoration).

hook.how: The film's statement on frame 0, fitted to the safe width, its first word on a strong onset.

moves.move: The key word in the italic of the serif, at full ink: never a colour darker than the ink.
A statement fitted to the width: display size set so the line spans the safe width.

measurable.how: The statement's ink spans at least 85 % of the safe width.

moves.move: Words fade in one after another, 80 ms apart.
A slow fade through the ground between statements.

allows.why: Nocturne fades through the ground between statements: a few frames of plain ground between two statements are the move.

props.picture: the picture under the statements (each statement may change it)
props.emphasis: the key word, set in the italic of the serif

blocks.for: The statements, word by word, fitted to the width; on a picture that fills the frame.
The thin rule above the caption.
A picture on its own, between statements. Under a statement, use quote's `picture`.
The bed, with the first word of each statement on a strong onset.
Display type sized to fill the safe width.

avoid.why: Nocturne arrives word by word, slowly.

ends.how: The last statement as a quote card, with the rule, name and role arriving with it and staying to the end.
ends.with: the last statement as the card, with the rule, name and role, held to the end

mix.note: Ambient piano. No effects: the words arrive in silence over the bed.

shots.match: One place: outside and inside share one axis and one light.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
a quote from a famous person
